Create sliding windows.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Time Series](../categories/time-series.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TimeSeriesWindow` |
| Search words | window, sliding, sequence |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input time-ordered table |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Windowed** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Windowed table with x_\* features, ordered y targets, and hidden target bounds |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value_col | `value_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric source/target column. |
| feature_cols | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Extra numeric feature columns to window. |
| time_col | `time_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional numeric time column. |
| segment_col | `segment_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional int64 segment column; windows cannot cross segment boundaries. |
| input_width | `input_width` | Integer | `12` |   | The run | Lookback steps per sample. |
| label_width | `label_width` | Integer | `1` |   | The run | Ordered forecast target steps. |
| shift | `shift` | Integer | `1` |   | The run | Forecast offset. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
